description: This file defines repository classes for database operations within the Sports Telecast Backend, including user, profile, match, event, and highlight repositories. It encapsulates database queries, relationships, and data manipulation methods for the application's data layer.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A base class providing common database session validation and shared properties for specific repositories.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository handling user data creation, retrieval, and update operations.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository for user profile creation, retrieval, and update.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository managing match-related data retrieval, including various filtered lists and counts of matches.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository for event data retrieval, supporting filtering and related match data.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository providing access to highlight data, including filtering by match.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record with provided data and hashed password.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique identifier.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates user information based on user ID.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user profile with specified data.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user profile by associated user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates profile data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of matches with optional status filtering.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a match along with related data by match ID.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all matches currently marked as live.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches matches scheduled within a certain number of days.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches_by_event_id(self, event_id: str, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves matches associated with a specific event.

methods.name: int get_total_matches_count(self, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None)
methods.description: Returns the total count of matches, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events with optional sport type filtering.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific event including its matches.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of highlights, optionally filtered by match.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a highlight record by ID.

methods.name: __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: unavailable
